description: Get this week's top value stocks meeting Graham + Buffett criteria, ranked by composite score (total_score). Returns up to 20 signals. Each signal includes: ticker, exchange, total_score, pe, pb, roe, margin_of_safety, sector (may be null), and moat_signals (array of passing criteria tags like 'PE<15', 'ROE>15%', 'FCF>0'). Also returns watch_count (total stocks on watchlist) and _meta with credit usage. Use for questions like 'what are the best value stocks this week?'. Costs 5 credits. Without a key, returns the top 3 signals as a free demo (20 calls/day, no key needed). Data is quantitative screening output, not personalised financial advice.
name: get_weekly_signals
title: This week's value-investing buy signals
